prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a hand-drawn VFX preproduction approval sheet for Catabase, an isometric tactical card game. This is a DRAWING of a proposed spell, not a screenshot, not production sprites.
Style: confident professional animation layout pencil-and-ink drawing, restrained flat cel colour, two or three hard value bands, expressive clean silhouettes, spare construction lines. Warm light ivory paper. No painterly fog, no bloom, no photorealism, no glossy 3D render. Effects have designed volumes that can be built as simple Blender meshes.
Composition: landscape 3:2 sheet, large generous drawings, a narrow title at top. Three main storyboard panels across the sheet taking most of the space. Under each, a short French label as specified. Each panel uses the SAME orthographic three-quarter tactical camera looking down about 30 degrees, diamond square-tile grid with 2:1 projected proportions, and the SAME grey simplified adult warrior mannequins at consistent scale. Feet grounded on the grid. Characters are neutral pose scale references, muted grey, no faces or costume details competing with the VFX. Spell shapes are coloured, fully legible, clearly in spatial perspective (never flat frontal icons). Each panel is a different temporal stage of ONE spell, not alternate spell variants. Small lower strip for requested production detail studies and palette swatches, generous empty margins. Thin motion arrows only when helpful, clear spatial direction, no diagram clutter.
Readable dark lettering; render only the specified French text verbatim. Do not invent extra labels, stats, lore, signatures or brand logos. Strong visual focus on the effect's design and silhouette.
Title text: "A — Chaînes du Tartare". Small subtitle: "GARDIEN · ATTRACTION".
Design: one chunky bronze U-shaped hooked shackle attached to a short chain of large articulated rectangular links. Warm bronze faces, very dark umber edges, a tiny pale gold contact accent. Readable volume and thickness, simplified Greek geometric craft, not medieval ornament. Only one tether, attached near the target's waist, never its neck.
Panel 1 label "01 · Accroche": caster lower-left, opponent upper-right three tiles away. A bronze hook on the leading end of a slack chain is just reaching the opponent's belt height; a little crease of motion shows its bite around empty air adjacent to the waist. One small bronze anchor ring floats beside the caster's forward hand, without requiring a body animation. Show the chain in isometric perspective.
Panel 2 label "02 · Traction": the same hook and chain snap taut towards the caster. Target has moved one tile closer, heels dragged toward caster; indicate previous target position using one tiny uncoloured dotted footprint and a single arrow pointing TOWARD caster. Restrained bright gold contact notch; no explosion, no circular shockwave.
Panel 3 label "03 · Dissipation": target stopped near caster, same scale. Chain opens and separates into a few dim bronze fragments disappearing. Clear silhouette of both characters and no cage or permanent tether.
Bottom strip: one close-up perspective study of a single thick chain link and the U-shaped hook, three colour swatches. Bottom note: "Attire jusqu’à 3 cases · aucun état persistant".
Make it a concrete, buildable and attractive spell concept rather than a generic magic effect.

Title text: "B — Jardin de givre". Small subtitle: "THAUMATURGE · TERRAIN".
Design: five low, angular icy rosettes grow from exactly five square tiles in a PLUS footprint: center tile and four orthogonal neighbours. Pale porcelain-blue leading edges, cyan midfaces, deep indigo undersides. Hard cel crystals resembling folded leaves, not a blanket of mist or a giant glacier. Never imply an impassable wall.
Panel 1 label "01 · Germination": same isometric square grid, one grey opponent standing on center tile. Exactly five thin pale blue cracks are forming, one rosette seed per affected tile. Other tiles remain empty.
Panel 2 label "02 · Éclosion": exactly five rosettes snap open together on the five-tile PLUS. The center rosette is visible around the standing opponent's feet, outer rosettes at the other four tile centers. Three or four chunky blade-like ice petals per rosette, peak only knee-high. A small sharp bright rim at the growth edge, visible spaces between tile effects, opponent remains readable.
Panel 3 label "03 · Terrain actif": rosettes have receded to low ankle-high icy ridges and thin frost veins confined to those same five tiles. One grey opponent walking onto an affected tile has two tiny ice chips briefly around one ankle, without encasing or freezing the whole character. Persistent shape stays low and readable.
Bottom strip: a close-up perspective study of one simple three-petal crystal rosette; next to it a tiny unlabelled sketch of petals shrinking flat at expiry; four colour swatches.
Bottom note: "5 cases en croix · terrain 2 tours · ralentissement à l’entrée".
Terrain duration is distinct from the short growth animation. Do not depict damage text, snowstorm, circular area, extra tiles, an ice cage, frozen statue or airborne ice meteor.

Title text: "C — Moisson des condamnés". Small subtitle: "ASSASSIN · COUP RENFORCÉ".
Design: a single oversized hooked sickle blade briefly materializes beside the target and carves one diagonal arc. Not a giant summoned reaper. Blade shape is a compact ancient harpe: obsidian-violet body, bone-ivory cutting edge, a short bronze tang, strong taper. About 1.3 times character height, never dominates the whole map. Minimal flat plum cel motion smear only where the blade travels, no nebulous aura.
Panel 1 label "01 · Armement": a grey opponent stands on one target tile. The hooked blade rises just above and behind their right shoulder, in the same three-quarter perspective as the grid, pre-swing. Show clear separation of blade and silhouette.
Panel 2 label "02 · Taille": the blade cuts diagonally down beside the target, one strong ivory curved cutting streak follows its edge; a single asymmetric angular plum-and-ivory impact slash at the torso, not a starburst on every side. Keep head and feet visible. All force is on ONE target tile. Grey opponent recoils slightly and remains intact.
Panel 3 label "03 · Retrait": blade fragments into two or three narrow wedges following the end of the arc and disappears; the grey opponent remains standing, no death assertion, no persistent seal.
Bottom strip: two SMALL blade-edge studies side by side labelled exactly "Normal" and "Cible ≤ 35 % PV". Normal is a narrow simple ivory edge; conditional stronger version has a broader ivory edge and one extra crisp impact notch, same overall volume and shape. Four small colour swatches.
Bottom note: "Le bonus renforce l’impact · ne promet pas une élimination".
No blood, gore, wounds, skull, ghost emerging from the target, death icon, health bar, circles, chains or lingering debuff.

Title text: "D — Volée du crépuscule". Small subtitle: "ARPENTEUR · SALVE EN CROIX".
Design: exactly five stout spectral arrows, smoke-dark green shafts, angular bronze broadheads, small jade fletching, pale warm ivory contact tips. Sharply designed short arrow volumes; strong silhouette suitable for one instanced Blender mesh. Their five landing points are exactly a PLUS of five square tiles in an isometric grid: center plus four orthogonal neighbours.
Panel 1 label "01 · Salve": five arrows grouped in a shallow fan above the target area, all aligned in the same downward flight direction, short clean cel trails. One grey opponent on center tile, one on a side tile; all scale matches other panels. No archer body animation is needed in this sheet, focus on projectile formation.
Panel 2 label "02 · Cinq impacts": exactly five arrows hit their five distinct tile centers in the PLUS footprint together. Five compact angular ivory/bronze ground chips, no giant explosion. The two grey opponents are readable with one brief contact streak each, and empty affected cells get only a small ground contact. No circular landing pattern and no more than five arrows.
Panel 3 label "03 · Extinction": same five tiles, fading short jade arrowhead-shaped echoes at impact points, shafts already gone, intact ground becoming clear; both grey figures visible. No persistent stakes, trapping net or lasting hazard.
Bottom strip: one large three-quarter perspective study of a single bronze arrowhead and jade fletching; one very small isometric five-tile footprint sketch; three colour swatches.
Bottom note: "5 cases en croix · une frappe groupée · aucune zone durable".
Make the epic power legible through coordinated timing and crisp broadheads, not excessive particles.
